confirmed.lensA: capture.py:10171-10174 swallows a scan exception and sets `seen = {}`, then unconditionally folds it: `presence_fold` (capture.py:10132-10148) iterates the CONFIGURED addresses and calls `oxy_presence.observe(..., seen_at=None)`, whose contract (oxy_presence.py:123-124) defines `seen_at=None` as "a tick that saw nothing" — so a window in which the radio could not look is encoded identically to an observed-silent window, and observe() has no third input to distinguish them; `Presence` (oxy_presence.py:86-96) carries no coverage/failed-window count, so nothing downstream can recover the difference. The consequence is a manufactured negative finding: with any prior sighting, sustained scan failures past 90 s hit oxy_presence.py:143-145 and return ABSENT with reason `silent Ns ≥ 90s` (a false sentence — it was never listened to), which re-arms the once-per-session latch at capture.py:10193-10194, publishes `presence`/`presence_reason` via `_set` at 10185, and feeds `sightings=0` into the power engine at capture.py:10213; the log's own "observation unchanged" is contradicted by the very next statement. The only existing test (tests/test_presence_wire.py:103-108) exercises just the cold-start case where prev is None, so its assertion "a failed scan is not a sighting and is not an absence" is vacuous for the failing path.
confirmed.lensB: Traced the failed-scan `seen = {}` (capture.py:10173) → presence_fold (capture.py:10148) → oxy_presence.observe(seen_at=None) → ABSENT with reason "silent Ns ≥ 90s" (oxy_presence.py:145); the Presence dataclass (oxy_presence.py:86) has no validity/coverage field, so consumers cannot distinguish it. It reaches three live consumers: the published STATUS via _set (capture.py:10185), the pull-latch re-arm _PRESENCE_PULLED.discard (capture.py:10194), and the power cadence sightings=0 (capture.py:10213); the loop is wired at capture.py:11040. Only mitigation is the arming config flag (oxy_presence.py:256/312) — a deployment switch, not a data guard — and capture.py:10188 names this exact hazard ("a scanner that goes blind would silently re-enable a pull") while the failed-scan path defeats it by yielding ABSENT instead of UNKNOWN.

The chosen ECG then feeds every fusion number with no indication the selection was made on a fabricated window.

The absence of a follow target also travels out-of-band in the same record and in the verdict `result` (`"follow": want` at ble_sniff.py:191, copied at 210-211), and the only reader branches under `if s["follow"]:` (ble_sniff.py:238-243), so no consumer in-tree mistakes it for a measured zero; the population is published separately at line 212. The only residual is cosmetic (a redundant guard), well below the §∅ bar.

At ble_sniff.py:388-399 absence is already represented as null, exactly per §∅: `cover = (span / expect_s) if (expect_s and span is not None) else None` and `window`/`expect_s` stay None — no zero, no default, no in-band sentinel is fabricated, and format_audit:405 suppresses the coverage/window lines entirely when `expect_s is None` rather than printing "0.00 coverage". `ok` at :398 is not a measurement but an absence-of-findings flag over the checks the CALLER requested; main():492 returns 0 without running audit() at all when nothing was requested, so whenever `ok` is emitted the foreign-connect arm (:380-382) has actually run on real parsed packets — the population is never empty. Declining to pass --expect-seconds is a caller choice not to ask for a window check, which is a documented option (:429, :442), not a path-manufactured value standing in for a measurement.
